editorial:
Imagine moving into a brand new home only to find out that the previous owners left behind something truly evil. You follow a young couple who think they found the perfect deal on a house, but things get weird fast. The vibe is super tense because you spend most of the time staring at grainy camera feeds, waiting for something to move in the background. It captures that scary feeling of being watched while you sleep, making you want to keep every single light in your house on after the credits roll.

What really works here is how the tension builds slowly until it finally snaps. The acting feels real, and the twists are genuinely shocking without being too confusing. While some parts might feel a bit slow if you want constant action, the payoff is worth the wait. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the small details in the dark corners. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the discovery that the couple was actually being lured into a trap by a demon that feeds on grief. In the final scene, the husband realizes the ghost is actually his own dead father trying to warn him. He tries to destroy the cursed object in the basement, but the demon wins and pulls him into the walls. The film cuts to black just as the wife hears his voice calling her name from the dark.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves found footage movies and jump scares.
